articles.title: DFIN Q3 2024 Earnings Call Transcript
articles.summary: Motley Fool: DFIN Q3 2024 Earnings Call Transcript. Dan Leib: Thank you, Mike. With net sales of $179.5 million and adjusted EBITDA of $43.2 million, resulting in an adjusted EBITDA margin of 24.1%. Specific to our third quarter performance, I am pleased with the continued strong demand for our software offerings, where we delivered year-over-year organic net sales growth of 13.6%. articles.title: Suze Orman Says Put 50% in VOO. Here’s Why She’s Right
articles.mainIdea: Suze Orman Says Put 50% in VOO. Here’s Why She’s Right
articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Suze Orman Says Put 50% in VOO. Here’s Why She’s Right. On a recent episode of her Women & Money podcast, Suze Orman fielded a listener letter from someone named Rachel worried her portfolio was too concentrated. Orman’s response cut straight to the point: “Put 50% of your money in VOO, then buy Nvidia, AMD, Palantir, IONQ.” The advice is blunt, memorable, and worth taking seriously ...
